# BAD-056 — One comment sweep over the web tier and the render service: start.js's head comment, four web-api pointers, and web/README.md's relay line

## Brief
One comment-only sweep over the web tier and the render service, merged from BAD-056, BAD-060 and BAD-061 (2026-09-16 triage). Each was filed as the out-of-scope tail of a different BAD-036 split; all three are prose, no code moves, and `npm test` already covers every file touched. Verified present on main e9f8709.

**1. `web/start.js:1-2` (was BAD-056).** Still reads "app.js wires handlers that booth.js defines, so booting from either file would depend on which one happened to load last" — true in effect but stale in wording now that `app.js` is the last of twelve app files wiring handlers from every view script. BAD-044 already reworded `app.js`'s own closing comment to "handlers that the other view scripts define"; match it. The spike notes this at `docs/spikes/bad-036/web-app.md` §5 ("Its comment ... goes stale in wording only").

**2. Four comments still naming `scripts/web-api.js` for code that moved (was BAD-060).** Outside BAD-049's PR 4 sweep, so PR 4 left them:
- `src/rendergate.js:73` "(as scripts/web-api.js does)" and `test/rendergate.test.js:59` "(scripts/web-api.js is one)" — both name the caller that threads `gateToken`'s options object, now `gateOf` in `scripts/web-api/gate.js`.
- `src/renderstore.js:8` "scripts/web-api.js's DELETE /session/:id routes to it" — the handler is now `deleteSession` in `scripts/web-api/route-session.js` (the entry still dispatches it).
- `scripts/web-local.js:13` "(web-api.js /api/dev-account ...)" — the handler is `devAccount` in `scripts/web-api/route-dev.js`.

Leave `src/rendergate.js:15` ("scripts/web-api.js hold no rule of their own") — still true, and it now covers the modules too. Also present and correct as written: `src/renderlocal.js:2` and `:38`, `src/rendergate.js:41` (both describe the historical `web-api.js`, deliberately). Spike §2e lists the set.

**3. `web/README.md:226` (was BAD-061).** Still says the public collab list's "thumbnails ride through the relay". The relay was removed on purpose — `web/CLAUDE.md:221-230` records it — and the thumb now goes through `Api.storagePut` (`collabweb-host.js`, `uploadCollabThumb`) and `Api.storageGet` (`collabweb-tab.js`, `loadThumb`): signed storage URLs, no Node process in between. Same staleness BAD-046 step 8 fixed inside `collabweb-model.js`, but this line sat outside the spike's named range.
